_meta.description: Reference library of retail products (core sets, unit expansions, Battle Force starter sets, card packs). This is the missing link between 'what a person owns' and 'which units/upgrades/command cards they therefore have physical miniatures/cards for' -- it's what data/units.json's currently-empty `expansion` field should eventually point back into, and what the collection-tracking database tables in src-tauri/migrations/0002_collection.sql are built against.
_meta.verification_status: EARLY SEED -- only 2 products populated out of what is realistically 100+ retail products released for this game since 2018. Both entries here were cross-checked against units.json/upgrades.json ids successfully. This library needs substantial future work before collection tracking is genuinely useful -- see docs/TODO.md. Every individual Unit Expansion box (one per unit, roughly) is a gap.

expansions.name: Upgrade Card Pack
expansions.notes: Generic, non-faction upgrade card pack -- exactly matches the 29 generic entries already seeded in data/upgrades.json. Quantities of each card in the physical pack (some cards likely print in multiples) were not confirmed, so contains_upgrades lists unique cards only, not physical counts.

expansions.name: 501st Legion Battle Force Starter Set
expansions.roster_source: https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/501st_Legion_Battle_Force_Starter_Set (Wookieepedia, fetched earlier this session); box contents cross-checked against starwarslegion.fandom.com's card list for the same product
expansions.notes: SWL123, released Sept 16 2022: 37 miniatures, 37 bases, 10 unit cards, 11 command cards, 34 upgrade cards. The unit contents (2x Phase II Clone Troopers, 3x ARC Troopers, 1x Republic AT-RT, 1x Anakin Skywalker) are confirmed. Of the 34 upgrade cards, only the 6 listed here were identifiable as cards already in data/upgrades.json (the generic pack). Several more upgrade names were seen in source material (Force Choke, EMP Droid Poppers, Smoke Grenades, JT-12 Jetpacks, Phase 2 Clone Trooper Personnel Upgrade, Phase 2 Mortar Trooper, Phase 2 Z6 Trooper, DC-15x ARC Trooper, Fives, Echo, ATRT Flamethrower/Laser Cannon/Rotary Blaster) but were NOT added here or to upgrades.json since they're not yet catalogued there -- see docs/TODO.md. None of the 11 command card names were identified in this pass.
